clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for flush bolts for use in cupboards and doors

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 2. Material a) Body and plate — Cast brass, cast aluminium and extruded aluminium alloy b) Bolt— Cast brass, extruded brass and extruded aluminium alloy. c) Spring— Phosphor bronze and steel strip.

clauses.title: Manufacture
clauses.text: 3. Manufacture — Rod shall be retained in its maximum bolting position by the spring.

clauses.title: Worksmanship and Finish
clauses.text: 5. Worksmanship and Finish — Shall have smooth and easy working when assembled. Brass bolts shall be satin or bright polished, or nickel or chromium plated or copper oxidized. Aluminium flush bolts shall be anodized. SUMMARY OF IS 5187 : 1972 FLUSH BOLTS (First Revision)
